ayahs.en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

ayahs.tj: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ ٤
ayahs.en: And who brings out the pasture

ayahs.tj: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ ٥
سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ ٦
ayahs.en: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

ayahs.ar: إِلّا ما شاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ يَعلَمُ الجَهرَ وَما يَخفىٰ
ayahs.tj: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ ٧
ayahs.en: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
And We will ease you toward ease.

ayahs.tj: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ ٩
ayahs.en: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
But the wretched one will avoid it -

ayahs.tj: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ١٢
ayahs.en: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لا يَموتُ فيها وَلا يَحيىٰ
ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ ١٣
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ١٤
ayahs.en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

ayahs.tj: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ١٥
ayahs.en: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

ayahs.tj: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٲةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ١٦
ayahs.en: But you prefer the worldly life,

ayahs.tj: وَٱلْأَخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ١٧
ayahs.en: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ١٨
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

ayahs.tj: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٲهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ ١٩
ayahs.en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
